utterances.text: Hi Daniel, it's Leo from Northwind Air. I'm calling about the quote we sent last week for the cold store extraction, the eight rectangular fans.
Ah, yes. Look, Leo, I'll be honest, we have an offer from another supplier that's about twelve percent lower.
Twelve percent, okay. Which models did they offer?
I'd have to check, something comparable, same size.
Look, I don't want to lose you over this. I can do fifteen percent off the whole order, no problem.
Fifteen? Okay, that changes things. And can you deliver by Friday? The installers are booked for Monday.
Friday is no problem, I guarantee it. We'll have them to you by Thursday even.
Yes, all eight. Don't worry about it.
Alright then. Send me the revised quote and I'll sign it today.
Will do, within the hour. Thanks Daniel.
